options.label: A
options.completeness: States mutmut 3+ source mutations, selected tests, run/browse workflow and retained work for continuation.

options.label: B
options.completeness: Includes source mutation and full command workflow, but gives false causal rationale that CPython has no bytecode.
options.wrong_defense: mutmut does operate on source, but that tool choice does not establish that CPython lacks bytecode; CPython compiles code and dis exposes its bytecode.

options.label: C
options.completeness: Covers mutation level and run/browse/history, but claims all mutations are assessed in one unchanged pytest run.
options.wrong_defense: A single mutmut run command is real, yet it orchestrates checks of changed mutants; it is not one unchanged test execution for every mutation.

options.label: D
options.completeness: Covers source mutation and command workflow, but denies history and says every repeat starts over.
options.wrong_defense: A full rerun can occur in some circumstances, but docs say mutmut remembers completed work and can resume; the blanket claim is false.
